Sneha Varghese
Data Engineer | Delhi NCR
sneha.varghese215@example.com | +91 9135474305

Versatile Data Engineer skilled in building reliable ETL pipelines and transforming business data into analytical assets. Focused on production-grade orchestration, data modeling, and performance tuning to enable timely analytics and reporting. Collaborative team player comfortable working in Agile environments and documenting work for cross-functional stakeholders.

Experience
PhonePe, May 2025 - Present
Data Engineer (Remote)
- Implemented dbt models to standardize merchant and transaction dimensional tables in Snowflake, reducing report join complexity and improving query performance by 35% for daily dashboards.
- Built and scheduled end-to-end pipelines using Apache Airflow and Python3 to ingest, validate, and load streaming events into Snowflake; achieved 99.7% pipeline success rate and reduced latency to under 10 minutes for near-real-time analytics.
- Optimized Spark-based transformation jobs and Snowflake warehouse sizing, cutting compute costs by 22% while maintaining SLA for hourly aggregation jobs.
- Developed Lambda functions and SQS-based retry workflows for error handling of failed payloads, and instrumented alerts in EC2-hosted monitoring services; tracked tasks and releases in Jira and documented runbooks in Confluence.

Projects
- Real-time Merchant Fraud Signals: Led development of a prototype using Python3 and Apache Spark to compute rolling risk scores, persisted to Snowflake and exposed via dbt models for downstream dashboards; prototype reduced false-positive rate in alerts by 12%.
- Backfill Automation Tool: Created Airflow DAGs to orchestrate controlled backfills into Snowflake with idempotent dbt runs, cutting manual intervention time by 80% during schema migrations.

Languages: Python3, SQL
